_comment: Training provenance for best_model.pt (ESM2-150M + LoRA r32 + temperature/pH gating).
Served by GET /dataset/stats. Most fields below are now REAL, read out of the
length_metrics/configuration keys. Fields still null or UNCONFIRMED are awaiting the
CONVENTION (verified empirically 2026-08-29): higher dG = MORE stable in raw model
units. Confirmed by mutating GB1's buried Trp43 to Asp — a known strongly
destabilising substitution — which moved the prediction DOWN by 14.6 kcal/mol. The
API negates at the boundary so the UI shows more-negative = more stable.
NOTE: the checkpoint's own region_metrics label the LOW dG band 'STABLE' and the HIGH
band 'UNSTABLE'. Those names are inverted with respect to the data. Raised with the

val_metrics._note: accuracy definition not yet supplied by the model author

dg_stats._source: decile edges of the validation label distribution

env_normalization.evidence: raw (37 C, pH 7) saturates env_gate (mean 0.9603, pinned at 1.0); inputs near 0 give a healthy spread (0.51-0.78), suggesting training used normalised values

tokenizer_max_length.status: checkpoint configuration says max_len=128; service still applies 514
tokenizer_max_length._note: No effect on the 40-80 aa training domains, but anything over 126 residues is processed outside the trained context. Decide before full-length work.

projector_activation.status: APPLIED 2026-08-29, pending author confirmation (Q1 in ml-questions.md)
projector_activation.issue: SiLU has no parameters, so it leaves no trace in a checkpoint and load_state_dict reports 0 missing / 0 unexpected whether or not it was trained with one. An earlier clean load was wrongly read as proof this block was a bare Linear.
projector_activation.evidence: Restoring SiLU: output span over 32 real sequences 39.10 -> 16.49 (labels 15.98); GB1 wild-type 11.11 -> 6.32 (literature ~5-6 kcal/mol); out-of-label-range predictions 12/32 -> 5/32. Same behaviour on both the epoch-4 and expert1 checkpoints.
projector_activation.ranking_impact: none - Spearman +0.9993 vs without. SiLU turns at x=-1.278 and the projector's minimum output is -1.146, so it is monotonic across the range in use.
projector_activation.revert: delete nn.SiLU() from protein_projector in ml-service/esm2_gated_model.py
